I downloaded and wanted to track my nap. I woke up half an hour later and whatever I did, I couldn't stop the sleep tracker from tracking. I tried killing and starting again, turning on sleep music, setting alarm etc nothing worked. It kept showing tracked DB. An app shouldn't be this hard to use.

Bad, what's the point if all you can do is see how long you sleep and not what you can do in you're sleep, why? because that is Premium and I did the free Premium thing but it didn't even work bro anyway yeah im uninstalling now.

This app is obnoxious about pushing premium. As soon as you open it, it pops up. When you try to do ANYTHING, a pop-up with an offer for premium appears. You can't view anything that would make this app actually useful on the free plan. Not even the sleep noises, because unlocking them with ads never works! The ad freezes every. single. time. And if you accidentally press the sign up button on one of the many pop-ups, you can't go back unless you close the app. Downright predatory.
You have to pay to get everything, glad to know all the people struggling with money cant fix anything or even hear what they say in their sleep due to a paywall.
